Fewer Providers, Fewer Headaches: PayDo Heads to Web Summit Lisbon
summary:
Meet the Team at Booth 451 and Hear Serhii Zakharov on the Panel Stage on November 11th
PayDo will exhibit at Web Summit Lisbon from 9 to 12 November 2026 at booth E451. Founder and CEO Serhii Zakharov will also speak on a panel about how digital businesses can run payments across borders without stitching together a different provider for every step.
Web Summit is one of the biggest technology events in the world. Last year it brought together more than 71,000 attendees from 157 countries and a record 2,725 startups. For PayDo, it is the place where the people who build and run internet businesses are all in one room, and where the team can have the practical conversations that rarely fit into a sales call.
Why PayDo is going
A large part of PayDo's client base is made up of technology companies. SaaS businesses, AI and software teams and platforms with customers in dozens of countries are among the fastest-growing groups the company works with, alongside clients in more than 25 other industries.
Those clients rarely ask for the same thing. A subscription business cares about failed renewals and local payment methods. An AI studio with contractors in several countries cares about payout day. A marketplace needs to split one customer payment between many sellers. PayDo's team builds around those differences, so each client gets a setup that fits how their business actually moves money, whether that means card acquiring, multi-currency accounts, open banking collections, payouts or FX, all under one contract and one integration.
"We spend our days with founders and finance leads who didn't choose a messy payment stack", – said Serhii Zakharov, Founder and CEO of PayDo. "They added one provider when they launched, another when they entered a new market, another when they started paying a remote team. Each decision made sense. Together they mean the finance team spends the first week of every month matching reports that don't agree. Web Summit is full of companies at exactly that stage”.
The panel: One Platform for Global Payments
Serhii Zakharov, Founder and CEO of PayDo, will take the stage at Web Summit Lisbon as one of the session speakers. On November 11, 10:35 the session at MoneyConf stage “One Platform for Global Payments: Solving Payments Complexity for Digital Businesses,” looks at what happens when a company outgrows its payment setup. Each new market tends to bring another provider, another currency and another set of rules. The discussion will cover how to choose a payment provider that understands your business model, risk profile and growth plans, rather than one that only processes transactions. It will also show how a single platform can handle the whole payment cycle, from accepting local payment methods to paying teams and suppliers across borders, and how that brings back speed, visibility and control over costs.
Serhii plans to share what PayDo sees every day from its clients: where money gets delayed between initiation and arrival, what hidden costs sit behind a transaction fee, and which questions to ask a provider before signing. He will keep it practical, with examples a founder can check against their own setup..
What you will find at booth E451
The PayDo team will be at the stand all week. Visitors can talk through:
card acquiring and local payment methods
multi-currency accounts for holding and paying out in the currencies a business actually uses
C2B open banking collections with a dedicated IBAN, so the business is notified when funds have arrived
cross-border payouts and FX
Bring your current setup, even if it is a spreadsheet and a list of logins. The team will sketch where your money changes hands, where fees add up and where reconciliation takes the most time, and tell you honestly whether PayDo is the right fit.
To book a meeting during Web Summit, contact the team.

content: PayDo is set to exhibit at Web Summit Lisbon from November 9 to 12, 2026. Founder and CEO Serhii Zakharov will speak on a panel on November 11 discussing global payment solutions for digital businesses. The team will showcase their multi-currency accounts, cross-border payouts, and payment processing services at booth E451 to help companies simplify complex financial operations.
